'''Lefry Kaonai''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] excavator who was part of a Republic archaeological team led by Doctor [[Kerrian]] that ventured in the [[Deep Cradle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. Unlucky, the entire expedition went insane; Lefry did not share their fate only because he had undertaken a Voss ritual that protected him from the influence of the [[Nightmare Lands]]. He was later saved by the arrival of the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] and the [[Voss Mystics|mystic-in training]] [[Gaden-Ko]].
